default_summary: Enthusiastic technical professional with 10+ years of experience managing enterprise systems. Specialized in the end-to-end lifecycle of financial infrastructure, having architected a global provisioning framework managing 20,000+ virtual machines. Expert in integrating complex API-driven workflows across VMware, ServiceNow, Infoblox, Rubrik, and Ansible Automation Platform to ensure 100% audit compliance. Proven track record of high-stakes problem solving, including $400k in direct licensing savings and the engineering of first-of-their-kind automated DMZ and SQL high-availability solutions.

bullets.label: Platform Engineering & Middleware
bullets.text: Designed and developed a custom Python orchestration application as middleware between ServiceNow and Ansible Automation Platform; implemented advanced retry logic, auto-remediation of deployment failures, and a pub/sub queue model for high-volume scaling.

bullets.label: Database as a Service (DBaaS)
bullets.text: Collaborated with Database Engineering to architect a high-performance on-premise SQL cluster, enabling a unified DBaaS offering that consolidated fragmented legacy databases and streamlined application delivery.

bullets.label: Cloud Abstraction & Redesign
bullets.text: Refactored legacy on-premise automation workflows to be fully cloud-agnostic, enabling seamless deployment to Azure; designed the logic to be transparent to end-users, maintaining a consistent interface while abstracting the underlying infrastructure provider.

bullets.label: Hybrid Cloud & GitOps
bullets.text: Architected GitOps-driven CI/CD pipelines using Terraform to automate the deployment of virtual machines to Azure; implemented a pull-request-based workflow that standardized infrastructure changes through automated plan/apply cycles.

bullets.label: End-to-End Hardening & Provisioning
bullets.text: Developed a zero-touch build workflow that delivers fully patched and hardened Linux (Ansible) and Windows (GPO) servers; automated agent installation, drive formatting, and optional hardened SQL deployments at scale.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Serve as a primary mentor for the Technology Development Program (TDP), setting enterprise-wide standards for naming conventions, Git branching strategies, and unit testing for infrastructure code.

bullets.label: Architectural Scale
bullets.text: Engineered a global server provisioning framework that deployed and managed 20,000+ virtual machines; integrated Rubrik and VMware APIs to automate backup and compute placement, ensuring 100% RTO/RPO compliance at build-time.

bullets.label: Infrastructure Resilience
bullets.text: Engineered and maintained a highly resilient infrastructure architecture spanning three identical, geo-redundant datacenters to ensure maximum uptime and disaster recovery readiness.

bullets.label: Network Security Automation
bullets.text: Automated Check Point firewall rule generation and DMZ provisioning; integrated security policy updates into the server build-cycle to ensure day-zero network isolation and hardened security posture.

bullets.label: Cost Optimization
bullets.text: Orchestrated the migration of 850 branch file servers within a strict 3-month window using custom PowerShell automation, avoiding $400,000 in extended licensing fees.

bullets.label: Operational Efficiency
bullets.text: Developed an intelligent IP provisioning engine via InfoBlox API integrations, eliminating 1,000+ annual engineer hours and resolving a multi-year infrastructure bottleneck.

bullets.label: Risk Mitigation
bullets.text: Authored Active Directory lifecycle scripts with built-in 'Read-Only' dry-run modes; implemented Least Privilege permissions and robust rollback protocols for stale object cleanup.

bullets.label: Performance Engineering
bullets.text: Diagnosed and resolved a mission-critical server hang by identifying a NUMA architecture mismatch; re-aligned vCPU/Memory topology to eliminate cross-node latency and restore system stability.

bullets.label: Security Architecture
bullets.text: Engineered a secure reverse proxy solution to protect sensitive internal infrastructure, enabling customer online ordering while mitigating external threat vectors.

bullets.label: Infrastructure Resilience
bullets.text: Architected a highly redundant DNS solution that significantly reduced network outages and optimized global traffic performance.

bullets.label: Cloud Connectivity
bullets.text: Established secure, encrypted VPN tunnels to bridge on-premise networks with cloud resources, ensuring seamless hybrid-cloud operations.

bullets.label: Enterprise Mobility
bullets.text: Successfully onboarded and managed 15,000 iPads via Meraki MDM, implementing automated security protocols including geo-fencing, remote-wipe triggers, and custom application deployment.

bullets.label: Cybersecurity Governance
bullets.text: Directed enterprise-wide vulnerability scanning and remediation efforts for internal and external systems to maintain a hardened security posture.

bullets.label: Network Administration
bullets.text: Managed complex firewall rules and switch ACLs for a massive distributed network spanning 12 airports and 3 satellite offices.

bullets.label: Proactive Monitoring
bullets.text: Developed service-aware alerting frameworks for business-critical systems, reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR) through proactive incident detection.

bullets.label: Disaster Recovery
bullets.text: Spearheaded the deployment of Datto backup and disaster recovery appliances to ensure 100% business continuity for critical operations.

bullets.label: Operational Visibility
bullets.text: Modernized infrastructure monitoring by designing custom Grafana dashboards to visualize real-time performance metrics.

education.degree: Bachelor Of Science in Computer Information Systems

volunteering.role: Thermal drone pilot for search and rescue missions.

cover_letter_example:
Dear Hiring Manager,

As a Senior Automation Engineer with over a decade of experience, I specialize in building infrastructure platforms that scale. At M&T Bank, I have been a driving force behind our hybrid cloud transition, specifically in refactoring legacy on-premise automations to work seamlessly within Azure. By designing an abstraction layer that is entirely transparent to the end-user, I enabled our development teams to leverage public cloud resources without changing their existing workflows—standardizing the provisioning experience across 20,000+ virtual machines.

My expertise lies in treating infrastructure as software. Whether it is architecting GitOps pipelines using Terraform, developing custom Python middleware to bridge ServiceNow and Ansible, or engineering a high-availability framework across three geo-redundant datacenters, my goal is always to deliver resilience through automation. I am particularly proud of my ability to mentor the next generation of engineers through M&T’s Technology Development Program, where I establish the standards for Git branching, unit testing, and technical governance that ensure our code remains audit-compliant and robust.

I am eager to bring my background in financial-grade automation, cloud abstraction, and platform engineering to your team. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,

David Kreuter
